strategy: existing World auto policy, identical actual player build at every rho
limits: Controlled enemy HP difficulty calibrated to rho = 0.75 * measured single-target DPS * paired actual incoming EHP / (boss HP * stationary raw boss DPS). Authored player build is never rescaled.

Full-health stationary raw/mitigated boss damage and a zero-armour nonattacking DPS target are separate measurements; later boss phases, active defence skills and player behaviour can differ from the nominal power ratio.
Win samples use the actual declared region, landing, obstacles, adds, boss phases, mana, cooldowns, HP, skill and weapon rules. Dead, timed out and invalid samples remain in the denominator.
Twenty seeds distinguish engine random outcomes, not a measured human skill distribution. Thresholds at 99% cannot establish population confidence with only twenty samples.
This Node engine probe does not award rewards or assert PostgreSQL settlement, natural acquisition, full dungeon routing or six-island production completion.
